title: QUIC RFC 9000 PADDING and PING Focused Proof
purpose: Describe the focused proof boundary for RFC 9000 PADDING and PING type encoding plus PING reachability and keep-alive probe semantics.
design_summary: The proof stays on the existing QuicFrameCodec fixed-type frame seam. PADDING is formatted and parsed as the single-byte variable-length integer value 0x00. PING is formatted and parsed as the single-byte variable-length integer value 0x01, and the existing ack-eliciting classifier remains the proof seam that a formatted PING can act as a reachability or keep-alive probe.
data_and_state_considerations: PADDING and PING carry no payload at this frame-codec boundary. The focused tests assert exact one-byte encoding, mismatched-type rejection, and rejection of longer varint encodings for the fixed frame type values. PING policy proof intentionally does not create timers; it proves the frame that policy code can use is well-formed and ack-eliciting.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Non-minimal two-byte varint encodings of 0x00 and 0x01 are rejected by the fixed-type parser because PADDING and PING are type-only frames encoded as one byte.
The reachability and keep-alive clauses are MAY-level policy permissions; this proof records the available ack-eliciting probe primitive rather than requiring proactive timer behavior.
PADDING semantic no-op behavior and packet-size padding remain owned by adjacent S19P1 requirements.
alternatives_considered: Keep broad QuicFrameCodec tests as the only proof; rejected because live triage requires requirement-owned focused evidence.
Add runtime timer behavior for optional PING keep-alive policy; rejected because the RFC clauses permit use of PING but do not require a new timer in this slice.
Fold remaining frame-family cleanup into this slice; rejected to keep the S19P1/S19P2 proof tail bounded.
risks: This proof does not claim a complete application-level keep-alive scheduler.
This proof does not broaden packet-processing close behavior for malformed fixed-type frames.
Other RFC 9000 tail families remain outside this slice.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This design covers focused S19P1/S19P2 PADDING and PING proof only: exact type encoding, mismatched-type rejection, non-minimal varint rejection, and ack-eliciting PING probe availability.
